meta.title: Musculoskeletal and Orthopaedic Rehabilitation | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Improving movement, strength and function after injury or surgery.

overview: At Cambridge Hospital, our musculoskeletal and orthopaedic rehabilitation services for rehabilitation and long-term care support patients recovering from joint surgery, fractures, sports injuries and chronic musculoskeletal conditions. A specialist team of physiotherapists and occupational therapists delivers structured, goal-oriented programmes across inpatient, outpatient and home care settings to support the restoration of strength, mobility and function, so that patients can return to the activities that matter most to them.
